1b:I[7179,["717","static/chunks/717-72a47cf9439eed04.js","531","static/chunks/app/(site)/rigs/%5Bslug%5D/page-f62b301f020efc1e.js"],"CopyLine"]
1c:I[2256,["717","static/chunks/717-72a47cf9439eed04.js","531","static/chunks/app/(site)/rigs/%5Bslug%5D/page-f62b301f020efc1e.js"],"CopyBlock"]
1d:Tec2,function solve(task, deadline) {
  const n = task.n, r = task.r, W = n >>> 5; // 448 bits -> 14 words
  const K = r >>> 5;                          // 224 bits -> 7 words
  // Build rows: M[k] has bit i = bit k of column i
  const M = [];
  for (let k = 0; k < r; k++) M.push(new Uint32Array(W));
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const hex = task.h[i];
    for (let b = 0; b < r / 8; b++) {
      const byte = parseInt(hex.substr(2 * b, 2), 16);
      for (let bit = 0; bit < 8; bit++) {
        if ((byte >> bit) & 1) {
          const k = b * 8 + bit;
          M[k][i >>> 5] |= (1 << (i & 31));
        }
      }
    }
  }
  const pop = (v) => {
    v = v - ((v >>> 1) & 0x55555555);
    v = (v & 0x33333333) + ((v >>> 2) & 0x33333333);
    return (((v + (v >>> 4)) & 0x0F0F0F0F) * 0x01010101) >>> 24;
  };
  const getBit = (row, i) => (row[i >>> 5] >>> (i & 31)) & 1;

  let bestW = Infinity, bestSet = null;
  const TARGET = 79;

  const buildSet = (e, xorVec, pivotCol) => {
    // e: array of free columns; xorVec: Uint32Array(K) bits over rows
    const set = e.slice();
    for (let k = 0; k < r; k++) {
      if ((xorVec[k >>> 5] >>> (k & 31)) & 1) set.push(pivotCol[k]);
    }
    return set;
  };

  while (Date.now() < deadline - 500 && bestW > TARGET) {
    // Copy matrix
    const A = M.map(row => Uint32Array.from(row));
    // random column order for pivot search
    const order = new Array(n);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) order[i] = i;
    for (let i = n - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
      const t = order[i]; order[i] = order[j]; order[j] = t;
    }
    const pivotCol = new Array(r);
    const isPivot = new Uint8Array(n);
    let used = 0;
    for (const c of order) {
      if (used === r) break;
      const w = c >>> 5, m = 1 << (c & 31);
      let p = -1;
      for (let k = used; k < r; k++) if (A[k][w] & m) { p = k; break; }
      if (p < 0) continue;
      const tmp = A[p]; A[p] = A[used]; A[used] = tmp;
      for (let k = 0; k < r; k++) {
        if (k !== used && (A[k][w] & m)) {
          const rk = A[k], ru = A[used];
          for (let q = 0; q < W; q++) rk[q] ^= ru[q];
        }
      }
      pivotCol[used] = c; isPivot[c] = 1; used++;
    }
    if (used < r) continue;

    // Free columns and their syndrome-like vectors V_j (bits over pivot rows)
    const free = [];
    for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) if (!isPivot[j]) free.push(j);
    const F = free.length;
    const V = new Uint32Array(F * K);
    for (let f = 0; f < F; f++) {
      const j = free[f];
      for (let k = 0; k < r; k++) {
        if (getBit(A[k], j)) V[f * K + (k >>> 5)] |= (1 << (k & 31));
      }
    }
    const popV = new Int32Array(F);
    for (let f = 0; f < F; f++) {
      let s = 0;
      for (let q = 0; q < K; q++) s += pop(V[f * K + q]);
      popV[f] = s;
      if (1 + s < bestW) {
        bestW = 1 + s;
        bestSet = buildSet([free[f]], V.subarray(f * K, f * K + K), pivotCol);
        if (bestW <= TARGET) break;
      }
    }
    if (bestW <= TARGET) break;

    // Lee-Brickell p=2
    const tmp = new Uint32Array(K);
    outer:
    for (let a = 0; a < F; a++) {
      const ao = a * K;
      for (let b = a + 1; b < F; b++) {
        const bo = b * K;
        let s = 0;
        for (let q = 0; q < K; q++) {
          s += pop(V[ao + q] ^ V[bo + q]);
        }
        const w = 2 + s;
        if (w < bestW) {
          for (let q = 0; q < K; q++) tmp[q] = V[ao + q] ^ V[bo + q];
          bestW = w;
          bestSet = buildSet([free[a], free[b]], tmp, pivotCol);
          if (bestW <= TARGET) break outer;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // Compose answer, sorted positions
  if (!bestSet) return [];
  const out = Array.from(new Set(bestSet)).sort((x, y) => x - y);
  return out;
}

29:Tdeb,function solve(task, deadline) {
  const N = 320, R = 160, W = 11; // W words per row: 320 columns + syndrome bit at index 320
  const hexBytes = (hx) => {
    const a = [];
    for (let b = 0; b < 20; b++) a.push(parseInt(hx.substr(2 * b, 2), 16));
    return a;
  };
  const M0 = new Uint32Array(R * W);
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
    const hb = hexBytes(task.h[i]);
    for (let j = 0; j < R; j++) {
      if ((hb[j >> 3] >> (j & 7)) & 1) M0[j * W + (i >> 5)] |= (1 << (i & 31));
    }
  }
  const sb = hexBytes(task.s);
  for (let j = 0; j < R; j++) {
    if ((sb[j >> 3] >> (j & 7)) & 1) M0[j * W + 10] |= 1;
  }
  const pc = (x) => Math.imul((x + (x >>> 4)) & 0x0F0F0F0F, 0x01010101) >>> 24;
  const pop5 = (a) => pc(a[0]) + pc(a[1]) + pc(a[2]) + pc(a[3]) + pc(a[4]);
  const M = new Uint32Array(R * W);
  const perm = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) perm.push(i);
  let best = null, bestW = Infinity;
  const TARGET = 62;

  while (Date.now() < deadline - 500) {
    for (let i = N - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const k = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
      const t = perm[i]; perm[i] = perm[k]; perm[k] = t;
    }
    M.set(M0);
    const piv = [];
    const isP = new Uint8Array(N);
    let rank = 0;
    for (let t = 0; t < N && rank < R; t++) {
      const k = perm[t], w = k >> 5, bt = 1 << (k & 31);
      let pr = -1;
      for (let j = rank; j < R; j++) if (M[j * W + w] & bt) { pr = j; break; }
      if (pr < 0) continue;
      if (pr !== rank) {
        for (let q = 0; q < W; q++) {
          const a = M[pr * W + q]; M[pr * W + q] = M[rank * W + q]; M[rank * W + q] = a;
        }
      }
      for (let j = 0; j < R; j++) {
        if (j !== rank && (M[j * W + w] & bt)) {
          for (let q = 0; q < W; q++) M[j * W + q] ^= M[rank * W + q];
        }
      }
      piv.push(k); isP[k] = 1; rank++;
    }
    if (rank < R) continue;
    const free = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) if (!isP[i]) free.push(i);
    // column vectors (over pivot rows) for each free column
    const cv = new Uint32Array(160 * 5);
    for (let f = 0; f < 160; f++) {
      const c = free[f];
      for (let j = 0; j < R; j++) {
        if (((M[j * W + (c >> 5)] >>> (c & 31)) & 1)) cv[f * 5 + (j >> 5)] |= (1 << (j & 31));
      }
    }
    const y0 = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0];
    for (let j = 0; j < R; j++) if (M[j * W + 10] & 1) y0[j >> 5] |= (1 << (j & 31));

    // build answer and record if better; returns true if target reached
    const consider = (y, T) => {
      let w = T.length;
      for (let k = 0; k < 5; k++) w += pc(y[k]);
      if (w >= bestW) return false;
      const pos = [];
      for (let j = 0; j < R; j++) if ((y[j >> 5] >>> (j & 31)) & 1) pos.push(piv[j]);
      for (const t of T) pos.push(free[t]);
      bestW = w; best = pos;
      return w <= TARGET;
    };

    if (consider(y0, [])) return best;
    const y1 = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0];
    for (let f = 0; f < 160; f++) {
      for (let k = 0; k < 5; k++) y1[k] = y0[k] ^ cv[f * 5 + k];
      if (consider(y1, [f])) return best;
    }
    const y2 = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0];
    for (let f1 = 0; f1 < 160; f1++) {
      const b1 = f1 * 5;
      for (let f2 = f1 + 1; f2 < 160; f2++) {
        const b2 = f2 * 5;
        y2[0] = y0[0] ^ cv[b1] ^ cv[b2];
        y2[1] = y0[1] ^ cv[b1 + 1] ^ cv[b2 + 1];
        y2[2] = y0[2] ^ cv[b1 + 2] ^ cv[b2 + 2];
        y2[3] = y0[3] ^ cv[b1 + 3] ^ cv[b2 + 3];
        y2[4] = y0[4] ^ cv[b1 + 4] ^ cv[b2 + 4];
        if (consider(y2, [f1, f2])) return best;
      }
    }
    if (Date.now() >= deadline - 500) break;
  }
  return best || [];
}

2a:Te96,function solve(task, deadline) {
  const iv = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) iv.push(parseInt(task.iv.substr(8 * i, 8), 16) >>> 0);

  const K = [];
  for (let n = 2, c = 0; c < 64; n++) {
    let p = true;
    for (let d = 2; d * d <= n; d++) if (n % d === 0) { p = false; break; }
    if (!p) continue;
    const cr = Math.cbrt(n);
    K.push(Math.floor((cr - Math.floor(cr)) * 4294967296) >>> 0);
    c++;
  }

  const rotr = (x, n) => ((x >>> n) | (x << (32 - n))) >>> 0;
  const S0 = x => (rotr(x, 2) ^ rotr(x, 13) ^ rotr(x, 22)) >>> 0;
  const S1 = x => (rotr(x, 6) ^ rotr(x, 11) ^ rotr(x, 25)) >>> 0;
  const s0 = x => (rotr(x, 7) ^ rotr(x, 18) ^ (x >>> 3)) >>> 0;
  const s1 = x => (rotr(x, 17) ^ rotr(x, 19) ^ (x >>> 10)) >>> 0;

  // 25-step compression of a 16-word block M, with feed-forward
  const w = new Uint32Array(25);
  function F(M) {
    for (let t = 0; t < 16; t++) w[t] = M[t];
    for (let t = 16; t < 25; t++) w[t] = (s1(w[t - 2]) + w[t - 7] + s0(w[t - 15]) + w[t - 16]) >>> 0;
    let a = iv[0], b = iv[1], c = iv[2], d = iv[3], e = iv[4], f = iv[5], g = iv[6], h = iv[7];
    for (let t = 0; t < 25; t++) {
      const ch = ((e & f) ^ (~e & g)) >>> 0;
      const T1 = (h + S1(e) + ch + K[t] + w[t]) >>> 0;
      const maj = ((a & b) ^ (a & c) ^ (b & c)) >>> 0;
      const T2 = (S0(a) + maj) >>> 0;
      h = g; g = f; f = e; e = (d + T1) >>> 0;
      d = c; c = b; b = a; a = (T1 + T2) >>> 0;
    }
    const r = [a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h];
    const out = new Uint32Array(8);
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) out[i] = (r[i] + iv[i]) >>> 0;
    return out;
  }

  const pc = x => {
    x = x - ((x >>> 1) & 0x55555555);
    x = (x & 0x33333333) + ((x >>> 2) & 0x33333333);
    return (((x + (x >>> 4)) & 0x0F0F0F0F) * 0x01010101) >>> 24;
  };

  const Ms = [];
  for (let m = 0; m < 4; m++) {
    const M = new Uint32Array(16);
    for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) M[i] = (Math.random() * 4294967296) >>> 0;
    Ms.push(M);
  }
  const outs = Ms.map(M => F(M));

  const totalCost = () => {
    let s = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
      const x = outs[0][i] ^ outs[1][i] ^ outs[2][i] ^ outs[3][i];
      s += pc(x >>> 0);
    }
    return s;
  };

  let cur = totalCost();
  let best = cur;
  let bestMs = Ms.map(M => Uint32Array.from(M));

  // tabu search: steepest move over all 512 bit flips of one message, rotating messages
  const tabuUntil = new Int32Array(2048);
  const X = new Uint32Array(8);
  let iter = 0;
  while (Date.now() < deadline - 500 && best > 82) {
    const m = iter++ & 3;
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
      let x = 0;
      for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) if (k !== m) x ^= outs[k][i];
      X[i] = x >>> 0;
    }
    let bc = Infinity, bkey = -1, bo = null;
    const M = Ms[m];
    for (let wi = 0; wi < 16; wi++) {
      for (let bit = 0; bit < 32; bit++) {
        const key = m * 512 + wi * 32 + bit;
        M[wi] = (M[wi] ^ (1 << bit)) >>> 0;
        const o = F(M);
        M[wi] = (M[wi] ^ (1 << bit)) >>> 0;
        let c = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) c += pc((X[i] ^ o[i]) >>> 0);
        if (tabuUntil[key] > iter && c >= best) continue;
        if (c < bc || (c === bc && Math.random() < 0.5)) { bc = c; bkey = key; bo = o; }
      }
    }
    if (bkey < 0) continue;
    const wi = (bkey >> 5) & 15, bit = bkey & 31;
    M[wi] = (M[wi] ^ (1 << bit)) >>> 0;
    outs[m] = bo;
    tabuUntil[bkey] = iter + 12 + ((Math.random() * 10) | 0);
    cur = totalCost();
    if (cur < best) {
      best = cur;
      bestMs = Ms.map(MM => Uint32Array.from(MM));
    }
  }

  const res = [];
  for (let m = 0; m < 4; m++) {
    let s = '';
    for (let t = 0; t < 16; t++) s += bestMs[m][t].toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
    res.push(s);
  }
  return res;
}

2b:T954,function solve(task, deadline) {
  const K = [];
  const primes = [];
  for (let n = 2; primes.length < 64; n++) {
    let ok = true;
    for (let d = 2; d * d <= n; d++) if (n % d === 0) { ok = false; break; }
    if (ok) primes.push(n);
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
    const c = Math.cbrt(primes[i]);
    const frac = c - Math.floor(c);
    K.push(Math.floor(frac * 4294967296) >>> 0);
  }

  const ivHex = task.iv;
  const IV = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) IV.push(parseInt(ivHex.substr(i * 8, 8), 16) >>> 0);

  const rotr = (x, n) => ((x >>> n) | (x << (32 - n))) >>> 0;
  const W = new Array(64);

  function F(M) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) W[i] = M[i] >>> 0;
    for (let t = 16; t < 64; t++) {
      const x = W[t - 15], y = W[t - 2];
      const s0 = (rotr(x, 7) ^ rotr(x, 18) ^ (x >>> 3)) >>> 0;
      const s1 = (rotr(y, 17) ^ rotr(y, 19) ^ (y >>> 10)) >>> 0;
      W[t] = (W[t - 16] + s0 + W[t - 7] + s1) >>> 0;
    }
    let a = IV[0], b = IV[1], c = IV[2], d = IV[3];
    let e = IV[4], f = IV[5], g = IV[6], h = IV[7];
    for (let t = 0; t < 64; t++) {
      const S1 = (rotr(e, 6) ^ rotr(e, 11) ^ rotr(e, 25)) >>> 0;
      const ch = ((e & f) ^ (~e & g)) >>> 0;
      const T1 = (h + S1 + ch + K[t] + W[t]) >>> 0;
      const S0 = (rotr(a, 2) ^ rotr(a, 13) ^ rotr(a, 22)) >>> 0;
      const maj = ((a & b) ^ (a & c) ^ (b & c)) >>> 0;
      const T2 = (S0 + maj) >>> 0;
      h = g; g = f; f = e;
      e = (d + T1) >>> 0;
      d = c; c = b; b = a;
      a = (T1 + T2) >>> 0;
    }
    const st = [a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h];
    const out = new Array(8);
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) out[i] = (st[i] + IV[i]) >>> 0;
    return out;
  }

  function lz(out) {
    let n = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
      if (out[i] === 0) { n += 32; continue; }
      n += Math.clz32(out[i]);
      break;
    }
    return n;
  }

  let best = null, bestLz = -1;
  const M = new Array(16).fill(0);
  let nonce = 0;
  const toHex = (arr) => arr.map(w => w.toString(16).padStart(8, '0')).join('');

  while (true) {
    if (Date.now() > deadline - 500) break;
    for (let k = 0; k < 4096; k++, nonce++) {
      M[0] = nonce >>> 0;
      M[1] = (nonce * 2654435761) >>> 0;
      const out = F(M);
      const z = lz(out);
      if (z > bestLz) {
        bestLz = z;
        best = toHex(M);
      }
    }
    if (bestLz >= 24) break;
  }

  return [best];
}

2c:Tf53,function solve(task, deadline) {
  const n = task.n, m = task.m, q = task.q;
  const A = task.a, t = task.t;
  const W = 50;
  const D = n + 1;

  const cen = v => { v = ((v % q) + q) % q; return v > q / 2 ? v - q : v; };

  // Basis of K = {z : A z = 0 mod q}, with A = [I | A'].
  // Rows: (-A'[:,j] mod q, e_j) for j in 0..71 and (q e_i, 0) for i in 0..23.
  const rows = [];
  for (let j = 0; j < n - m; j++) {
    const r = new Array(D).fill(0);
    for (let i = 0; i < m; i++) r[i] = cen(-A[i][j]);
    r[m + j] = 1;
    r[D - 1] = 0;
    rows.push(r);
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < m; i++) {
    const r = new Array(D).fill(0);
    r[i] = q;
    rows.push(r);
  }
  // Kannan embedding target row: (x0, W) with x0 = (t, 0)
  const x0 = new Array(D).fill(0);
  for (let i = 0; i < m; i++) x0[i] = cen(t[i]);
  x0[D - 1] = W;
  rows.push(x0);

  const b = rows;
  const N = b.length;
  const dot = (u, v) => { let s = 0; for (let i = 0; i < D; i++) s += u[i] * v[i]; return s; };

  // Floating Gram-Schmidt initial
  const mu = Array.from({ length: N }, () => new Float64Array(N));
  const Bn = new Float64Array(N);
  const bs = Array.from({ length: N }, () => new Float64Array(D));
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
    for (let k = 0; k < D; k++) bs[i][k] = b[i][k];
    for (let j = 0; j < i; j++) {
      let s = 0;
      for (let k = 0; k < D; k++) s += b[i][k] * bs[j][k];
      mu[i][j] = s / Bn[j];
      for (let k = 0; k < D; k++) bs[i][k] -= mu[i][j] * bs[j][k];
    }
    let s = 0;
    for (let k = 0; k < D; k++) s += bs[i][k] * bs[i][k];
    Bn[i] = s;
  }

  // LLL (Cohen Algorithm 2.6.3 style), delta = 0.99
  const delta = 0.99;
  let k = 1;
  while (k < N) {
    for (let j = k - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
      if (Math.abs(mu[k][j]) > 0.5) {
        const r = Math.round(mu[k][j]);
        const bk = b[k], bj = b[j];
        for (let l = 0; l < D; l++) bk[l] -= r * bj[l];
        mu[k][j] -= r;
        for (let l = 0; l < j; l++) mu[k][l] -= r * mu[j][l];
      }
    }
    if (Bn[k] < (delta - mu[k][k - 1] * mu[k][k - 1]) * Bn[k - 1]) {
      // swap rows k-1 and k
      let tmp = b[k]; b[k] = b[k - 1]; b[k - 1] = tmp;
      const m0 = mu[k][k - 1];
      const B = Bn[k] + m0 * m0 * Bn[k - 1];
      mu[k][k - 1] = m0 * Bn[k - 1] / B;
      Bn[k] = Bn[k - 1] * Bn[k] / B;
      Bn[k - 1] = B;
      for (let j = 0; j < k - 1; j++) {
        const t2 = mu[k][j]; mu[k][j] = mu[k - 1][j]; mu[k - 1][j] = t2;
      }
      for (let i = k + 1; i < N; i++) {
        const tt = mu[i][k];
        mu[i][k] = mu[i][k - 1] - m0 * tt;
        mu[i][k - 1] = tt + mu[k][k - 1] * mu[i][k];
      }
      k = Math.max(1, k - 1);
    } else {
      k++;
    }
    if (Date.now() > deadline - 500) break;
  }

  // Extract best candidate: rows whose last coord is +-W, first m-part valid.
  let best = null, bestN = Infinity;
  const check = x => {
    // verify A x = t mod q
    for (let i = 0; i < m; i++) {
      let s = x[i];
      for (let j = 0; j < n - m; j++) s += A[i][j] * x[m + j];
      if (((s - t[i]) % q + q) % q !== 0) return false;
    }
    return true;
  };
  for (let r = 0; r < N; r++) {
    const v = b[r];
    if (Math.abs(v[D - 1]) !== W) continue;
    const sg = v[D - 1] === W ? 1 : -1;
    const x = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) x.push(cen(sg * v[i]));
    let nn = 0;
    for (const xi of x) nn += xi * xi;
    if (nn < bestN && x.every(xi => xi >= -128 && xi <= 127) && check(x)) {
      bestN = nn; best = x;
    }
  }
  if (!best) {
    // fallback: shortest row, reduced into coset check
    for (let r = 0; r < N; r++) {
      const v = b[r];
      const sg = v[D - 1] >= 0 ? 1 : -1;
      const x = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) x.push(Math.max(-128, Math.min(127, sg * v[i])));
      if (check(x)) {
        let nn = 0; for (const xi of x) nn += xi * xi;
        if (nn < bestN) { bestN = nn; best = x; }
      }
    }
  }
  return best || new Array(n).fill(0);
}

2d:Tc90,function solve(task, deadline) {
  const q = task.q;
  const n = task.n;          // 96
  const m = task.m;          // 24
  const cols = n - m;        // 72
  const a = task.a;
  const lim = deadline - 500;

  // Build q-ary lattice basis: L = { x : x_top + A' x_bot = 0 mod q }
  const b = [];
  for (let j = 0; j < cols; j++) {
    const v = new Float64Array(n);
    for (let i = 0; i < m; i++) {
      let t = (((-a[i][j]) % q) + q) % q;
      if (t > q / 2) t -= q;
      v[i] = t;
    }
    v[m + j] = 1;
    b.push(v);
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < m; i++) {
    const v = new Float64Array(n);
    v[i] = q;
    b.push(v);
  }

  const dot = (u, v) => {
    let s = 0;
    for (let c = 0; c < n; c++) s += u[c] * v[c];
    return s;
  };

  // Gram-Schmidt
  const bs = [];
  const Bs = new Float64Array(n);
  const mu = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    mu.push(new Float64Array(n));
    const s = Float64Array.from(b[i]);
    for (let j = 0; j < i; j++) {
      const r = dot(b[i], bs[j]) / Bs[j];
      mu[i][j] = r;
      for (let c = 0; c < n; c++) s[c] -= r * bs[j][c];
    }
    bs.push(s);
    Bs[i] = dot(s, s);
  }

  // LLL (Cohen-style incremental)
  const delta = 0.99;
  let k = 1;
  while (k < n) {
    if (Date.now() > lim) break;
    for (let j = k - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
      const r = Math.round(mu[k][j]);
      if (r !== 0) {
        const bk = b[k], bj = b[j];
        for (let c = 0; c < n; c++) bk[c] -= r * bj[c];
        mu[k][j] -= r;
        for (let i = 0; i < j; i++) mu[k][i] -= r * mu[j][i];
      }
    }
    const lhs = Bs[k];
    const rhs = (delta - mu[k][k - 1] * mu[k][k - 1]) * Bs[k - 1];
    if (lhs >= rhs) {
      k++;
    } else {
      const mm = mu[k][k - 1];
      const Bk = Bs[k] + mm * mm * Bs[k - 1];
      mu[k][k - 1] = mm * Bs[k - 1] / Bk;
      Bs[k] = Bs[k - 1] * Bs[k] / Bk;
      Bs[k - 1] = Bk;
      const tmp = b[k]; b[k] = b[k - 1]; b[k - 1] = tmp;
      for (let c = 0; c < k - 1; c++) {
        const t2 = mu[k][c]; mu[k][c] = mu[k - 1][c]; mu[k - 1][c] = t2;
      }
      for (let i = k + 1; i < n; i++) {
        const t = mu[i][k];
        mu[i][k] = mu[i][k - 1] - mm * t;
        mu[i][k - 1] = t + mu[k][k - 1] * mu[i][k];
      }
      k = Math.max(1, k - 1);
    }
  }

  // Evaluate: linf of a vector
  const linf = v => {
    let mx = 0;
    for (let c = 0; c < n; c++) {
      const x = Math.abs(v[c]);
      if (x > mx) mx = x;
    }
    return mx;
  };

  let best = null;
  let bestM = Infinity;
  const consider = v => {
    const mx = linf(v);
    if (mx > 0 && mx < bestM) {
      bestM = mx;
      best = Float64Array.from(v);
    }
  };
  for (const v of b) consider(v);

  // Try small combinations of the shortest basis vectors
  const top = b.slice(0, Math.min(24, n));
  for (let i = 0; i < top.length && Date.now() < lim; i++) {
    for (let j = i + 1; j < top.length && Date.now() < lim; j++) {
      const s = new Float64Array(n), d = new Float64Array(n);
      for (let c = 0; c < n; c++) {
        s[c] = top[i][c] + top[j][c];
        d[c] = top[i][c] - top[j][c];
      }
      consider(s);
      consider(d);
    }
  }

  const out = [];
  for (let c = 0; c < n; c++) out.push(best ? best[c] : 0);
  return out;
}
22:["$","details","lattice.linf",{"className":"spoiler solver","children":[["$","summary",null,{"children":["Lattice SVP",", ","SIS, infinity norm",[" · best ",70,"% of target"]," · ",125," lines"]}],["$","$L1c",null,{"text":"$2d","maxHeight":360}]]}]
2e:Tc56,function solve(task, deadline) {
  const n = task.n;
  const m = task.clauses.length;
  const W = task.weights || new Array(m).fill(1);
  const C = new Int32Array(m * 3);
  for (let c = 0; c < m; c++) for (let j = 0; j < 3; j++) C[c * 3 + j] = task.clauses[c][j];

  // occurrence lists: entry = c*2 + (positive ? 1 : 0)
  const occCount = new Int32Array(n + 1);
  for (let i = 0; i < m * 3; i++) occCount[Math.abs(C[i])]++;
  const occ = [];
  for (let v = 0; v <= n; v++) occ.push(new Int32Array(occCount[v]));
  const fill = new Int32Array(n + 1);
  for (let c = 0; c < m; c++) for (let j = 0; j < 3; j++) {
    const l = C[c * 3 + j], v = Math.abs(l);
    occ[v][fill[v]++] = c * 2 + (l > 0 ? 1 : 0);
  }

  const val = new Uint8Array(n + 1);
  for (let v = 1; v <= n; v++) val[v] = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 1 : 0;
  const litTrue = (l) => (l > 0 ? val[l] === 1 : val[-l] === 0);

  const numTrue = new Int32Array(m);
  const dw = new Float64Array(m);
  for (let c = 0; c < m; c++) dw[c] = W[c];
  const uList = new Int32Array(m), uPos = new Int32Array(m).fill(-1);
  let uCount = 0, real = 0;
  const addU = (c) => { uPos[c] = uCount; uList[uCount++] = c; real += W[c]; };
  const remU = (c) => {
    const p = uPos[c], last = uList[--uCount];
    uList[p] = last; uPos[last] = p; uPos[c] = -1; real -= W[c];
  };
  for (let c = 0; c < m; c++) {
    let t = 0;
    for (let j = 0; j < 3; j++) if (litTrue(C[c * 3 + j])) t++;
    numTrue[c] = t;
    if (t === 0) addU(c);
  }

  // weighted break cost of flipping v (dynamic weights)
  const breakW = (v) => {
    let s = 0;
    const o = occ[v];
    for (let i = 0; i < o.length; i++) {
      const e = o[i], c = e >> 1, pos = (e & 1) === 1;
      if (numTrue[c] === 1 && (pos ? val[v] === 1 : val[v] === 0)) s += dw[c];
    }
    return s;
  };

  const flip = (v) => {
    const old = val[v];
    const o = occ[v];
    val[v] = old ^ 1;
    for (let i = 0; i < o.length; i++) {
      const e = o[i], c = e >> 1, pos = (e & 1) === 1;
      const wasTrue = pos ? old === 1 : old === 0;
      if (wasTrue) {
        numTrue[c]--;
        if (numTrue[c] === 0) addU(c);
      } else {
        if (numTrue[c] === 0) remU(c);
        numTrue[c]++;
      }
    }
  };

  let best = real, bestVal = Uint8Array.from(val);
  const p = 0.4;
  let iter = 0;
  while (best > 0) {
    if ((iter & 255) === 0 && Date.now() > deadline - 500) break;
    iter++;
    if (uCount === 0) break;
    const c = uList[Math.floor(Math.random() * uCount)];
    let bestV = -1, bestB = Infinity;
    for (let j = 0; j < 3; j++) {
      const v = Math.abs(C[c * 3 + j]);
      const b = breakW(v);
      if (b < bestB) { bestB = b; bestV = v; }
    }
    let pick = bestV;
    if (bestB > 0 && Math.random() < p) {
      pick = Math.abs(C[c * 3 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 3)]);
    }
    flip(pick);
    if (bestB > 0) {
      // SAPS-like weight bump on unsatisfied clauses
      for (let i = 0; i < uCount; i++) dw[uList[i]] += 1;
    }
    if (real < best) {
      best = real;
      bestVal = Uint8Array.from(val);
    }
  }

  const out = [];
  for (let v = 1; v <= n; v++) if (bestVal[v] === 1) out.push(v);
  return out;
}
